description: Ask Lee is the teas.co.uk tea adviser, the same one as the chat on teas.co.uk. Use this when someone asks a tea question in plain English or wants to chat about tea: "a strong morning tea that takes milk", "something caffeine free for bedtime under 5p a cup", "is Yorkshire Tea stronger than PG Tips", "what is rooibos", "do you deliver to France". It reads negations, budgets and time of day and answers from the shop's own product facts. Pass conversation_id from the previous answer to carry on the same conversation. Returns the answer in words, how sure it is, the teas it used with live prices, Tea Wiki articles and follow up questions, in a chat card where the person can keep asking.

brief.description: Optional: interpreted_request.brief from the last answer with one condition taken out, to ask the same message again without it (price_limit, strength, with_milk, caffeine, kind, format, exclusions, allergy).

conversation_id.description: From the previous Ask Lee answer, to carry on the same conversation. Leave out to start a new one.

language.description: Optional: the language the person writes in (en, fr, de, es, nl, it, pl, pt, tr, ja, zh-hant). Found from the message when left out. The answer comes in that language when Ask Lee can write all of it there (answer_language says which); otherwise it is English, so reply to the person in their language.

message.description: What the person said, in their own words.

name: ask_lee

answer.description: The answer in words, from the Ask engine.

answer_en.description: The English answer, when answer is in another language.

answer_language.description: The language the answer is written in: the language of the question when Ask Lee could write all of it there, else en.

conversation_id.description: Pass this back with the next message.

general.description: True when this is the general guide for the type of tea rather than the pack instructions.

format.description: Tea bags, loose leaf, pods and so on.

id.description: The product id (SKU) every tool accepts.

kind.description: Type of drink, for example Black tea.

pack.description: Pack size, for example 80 bags, 250 g.

price.description: Live price in pounds including VAT.

was_price_text.description: The usual price when the product is on offer.

question_in_english.description: How Ask Lee read a question that was not in English.

question_language.description: The language the question was written in (en, fr, de, es, nl, it, pl, pt, tr, ja, zh-hant).

turns.description: The conversation so far (latest last), for the chat card.

id.description: Wiki article id; read_wiki_article accepts it.

title: Ask Lee
